customManagers.description: Track pinned Alpine apk packages against the Alpine CDN index via the shared custom.alpine datasource (supplied by the alpine preset). extractVersionTemplate selects this package's .apk from the directory listing; the \d anchor after the name stops a prefix package from matching a longer sibling. IMPORTANT: bump alpine version in depNameTemplate when the base image changes (e.g. alpine_3_24 -> alpine_3_25) — that one edit also drives the registry URL, which the preset derives from the depName prefix.

packageRules.description: Never auto-update vendored Proton SRP code — manual re-vendor only

Isolate @protontech/drive-sdk bumps in their own PR and never automerge — a human reads the diff and CI verdict before merging. History: 0.15.x+ pulls a @protontech/crypto ^2.0.0 peer that ships bare .ts source (no compiled JS/.d.ts), which plain `node dist` cannot type-strip (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING) and tsc rejects (TS5097). UNBLOCKED 2026-07-23 via Tier 1: the server now runs under `tsx` (esbuild loader compiles the peer's .ts on demand), server tsconfig sets `allowImportingTsExtensions: true`, and src/types/protontech-crypto-shims.d.ts declares Uint8Array.toHex. Every 0.x minor still carries breaking API changes: 0.17.0 dropped MaybeNode/DegradedNode and unwrapped node returns (NodeEntity, with name as a Result); 0.19.x added SRPModule.generateKeySalt and retyped SessionKey (algorithm: symmetricNames, aeadAlgorithm: aeadNames | undefined); 0.20.0 renamed the whole sharing surface public-link -> URL-access, renamed NodeEntity.isSharedPublicly -> isSharedByUrl, and unwrapped activeRevision from Result<Revision, Error> to Revision. dependencyDashboardApproval was REMOVED 2026-08-03: every one of those breaks is a compile error, and CI already runs `tsc --noEmit` across the main and vendor projects, so hand-ticking a dashboard box added latency without adding detection — it gated PR creation, not merge. Do NOT re-add it to buy review time; `automerge: false` is what holds the merge, and it stays. On any bump, re-run typecheck against drive/{client,srp-module,crypto-module}.ts and re-verify tests before merging; the residual risk this rule cannot catch is a change that typechecks but behaves differently, which only reading the diff will find.

tini lives in the Alpine community repository. Custom datasources use registryStrategy 'first', so this REPLACES the main index rather than adding to it — listing both URLs would warn and use only the first. The URL derives its release line from the depName, so an Alpine bump stays a one-line edit to depNameTemplate. A community package missing from this rule is SILENTLY untracked: no warning, no dashboard entry. See owine/renovate-config README.
